details: The agent faithfully executed the proposed analysis in analysis_info.json. Both Task1 (multimethod) and Task2 (paired t-test with 90% node-retention) were run on the specified original datasets (FINAL fluency.csv and FINAL open.csv). For Task1, the agent produced the required outputs for all three approaches: Approach 1 (paired t-test on 90% node bootstraps) with ASPL means, t-statistic, and p-value; Approach 2 (participant bootstraps) with Pearson correlation and OLS results (including a model controlling for word count, as planned); and Approach 3 (binned by LATENT) with correlation results. For Task2, the 90% node-retention paired t-test was executed as specified. Structured artifacts (_artifacts/task1_results.json, _artifacts/task2_results.json) contain the requested metrics. Minor code/environment repairs (adding runtime package installation) were within allowed bounds and did not alter the analysis design. No major deviations from the planned methods, variables, or models were observed.
